messages:
riley_cs: FYI QBR vs EBR split conversation for Oakridge next Thurs 9am PT. Need slide owners + top 2 renewal exposures by Tue EOD.

noor_pm: I can take account health + usage trends. Will pull monthly active seats and embedding calls.

ashley_se: I'll own onboarding progress and blocked playbooks. Quick question: do we include a short checklist or a status heatmap?

riley_cs: Heatmap would be ideal — 1 slide. Keep checklist as appendix.

ton y_eng: I'll produce the cost delta chart (token spend vs committed). Posting link in QBR folder when ready.

eva_exec: For exec slide, please distill each risk into: one-line impact, recommended action, owner, ETA. I don't want technical detail.

ashley_se: Noted. Enablement asks so far: 1) tailored runbook, 2) spot training for POCs, 3) examples for prompt tuning.

ops_bot: QBR folder created: https://redwood.app/qbr/oakridge-5260000000. Deck template uploaded.

noor_pm: Proposed slide owners: account health (noor_pm), onboarding (ashley_se), risks (riley_cs + noor_pm), exec asks (eva_exec), cost (tony_eng).

riley_cs: Can we meet 30m Wed 11am PT to review slides? I'll send invite.

tony_eng: Uploaded cost chart: https://redwood.app/qbr/oakridge-5260000000/cost-trend.png. Shows 12% month-over-month rise last 2 months.

noor_pm: I'll draft renewal exposure language and share by Tue 4pm PT.

riley_cs: Thanks team. If owners confirm by Tue EOD we'll lock the agenda and send invites to Oakridge execs. :white_check_mark:
